title_en: Houses built and tap water at home
why_it_matters_en: People hear big claims about how many houses were built for the poor in towns and how many village homes now get tap water. These official counts show sanctioned, started and finished houses, and how many rural homes had a tap in 2019 versus today, district by district.
why_it_matters_te: పేదలకు ఎన్ని ఇళ్లు కట్టారు, ఎన్ని గ్రామ ఇళ్లకు నల్లా నీళ్లు వచ్చాయి అని పెద్ద మాటలు వింటాం. ఈ ప్రభుత్వ లెక్కలు మంజూరైన, మొదలైన, పూర్తైన ఇళ్లను, 2019 లో ఎన్ని ఇళ్లకు నల్లా ఉంది, ఇప్పుడు ఎన్నింటికి ఉంది అనేది జిల్లాల వారీగా చూపిస్తాయి.

points.page_or_table: state view, row Andhra Pradesh (fields Total, Value, Per, HCPWS_01042019)
points.note: Main value is households with a tap as on date.

caveats_en: Counts are what the state reported into the mission's online system. 'Total rural households' is revised over time; the site notes the AP total was reduced after a village directory reconciliation.

The dashboard labels the starting figure 'as on 15 Aug 2019', but the stored field is named for 1 April 2019 and equals the J36 'as on 01/04/2019' figure. The J36 report shows no AP connections in April to July 2019, so both dates give the same number.
The dashboard also shows 'remaining' and 'provided since launch'. Those are worked out by the page from these figures, so they are not stored here.
caveats_te: ఇవి రాష్ట్రం ఆన్‌లైన్ వ్యవస్థలో నమోదు చేసిన లెక్కలు. మొత్తం గ్రామీణ కుటుంబాల సంఖ్య కాలక్రమంలో మారుతుంది; గ్రామాల జాబితా సరిచేసిన తర్వాత AP మొత్తం తగ్గిందని సైట్ చెబుతోంది.

డాష్‌బోర్డ్ ప్రారంభ సంఖ్యను '15 ఆగస్టు 2019 నాటికి' అని చూపుతుంది, కానీ అదే సంఖ్య J36 నివేదికలో '1 ఏప్రిల్ 2019 నాటికి' అని ఉంది. 2019 ఏప్రిల్ నుండి జులై వరకు AP లో కొత్త కనెక్షన్లు లేవని J36 చూపుతుంది.
'మిగిలినవి', 'మిషన్ మొదలయ్యాక ఇచ్చినవి' అనే సంఖ్యలను పేజీ లెక్కిస్తుంది; అవి ఇక్కడ పెట్టలేదు.

refresh.how: Urban housing: open https://pmay-urban.gov.in/pmayprogress and follow 'State Wise Progress' (file name changes with each upload; read the 'as on' date in the PDF). Tap water: J36 at https://ejalshakti.gov.in/JJM/JJMReports/Physical/JJMRep_HouseholdTapWaterConnection.aspx (open https://ejalshakti.gov.in/JJM/Login.aspx first in the same session, then post FinYear and State=2 for AP districts; script jjm_fetch.py). Live totals: POST https://ejalshakti.gov.in/jjmreport/JJMIndia.aspx/Bind_table_graph with the page's encoded StCode11 (0 India, 37 AP); script jjm_dash.py.
refresh.cadence: Urban housing PDF: irregular, a new 'as on' edition every few weeks to months. Tap water: updated daily.
refresh.notes: J36 and the dashboard are HTML/JSON and parse cleanly. The urban PDF is a single-page table with Indian digit grouping and lakh/crore units in the total row. Only the newest urban edition stays on the site, so each new edition should be saved when it appears.

gaps: Rural housing: no AP figures. Both official reporting sites refused (connection reset, HTTP 401) and two more were not reachable from this session.

Urban housing: only the newest state-wise edition (as on 28 Sep 2026) is on the site. Older state-wise editions (2015 to 2025) are not linked anywhere on pmay-urban.gov.in; the only older AP figures found are grounded and completed counts from the 8 June 2021 review deck. Archive copies were not used, by rule.

Urban housing: no 'demanded' or 'validated demand' column in the current edition, and no separate breakup between the first phase and version 2.0 for AP (only 'Not Started (PMAY-U)' and 'Yet to Start (PMAY-U 2.0)').
Urban housing: no district table. A city-wise PDF exists (City_wise_Progress_PMAY-U_090925.pdf, 97 pages, kept in raw/) but it prints no 'as on' date and no state total, so it was not loaded.
Tap water: the source still uses 26 districts (and 13 before 2022-23). Nothing is available on the 28-district map yet.
Tap water: the 2019-2020 J36 table starts on 1 April 2019; the mission start (15 Aug 2019) figure is the same number by the dashboard's own label.
Tap water: counts are connections reported by the state. Whether water actually flows daily (functionality) is not in these tables.
